name: factor interacting with PAPOLA and CPSF1
pathways: mRNA 3'-end processing by stem-loop binding and cleavage

function.text: FIP1L1 encodes pre-mRNA 3'-end-processing factor FIP1. It participates in mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA 3'-end processing by stem-loop binding and cleavage.
